title: New Update Completely Messes Things Up
body:
I now have to wait for more than 10 seconds for each item I’ve clicked on to update. I have habits I’ve been doing for more than 600 days now, and the app has suddenly become slow and unresponsive.

This update was completely unnecessary, why did you need to break something that was working fine!?

Please fix this issue, managing a list should not be this slow.
author: InnenTensai
